description: The recruiting pool: creators on a current TikTok LIVE board, live ones first, with today's score, a 30-day diamond estimate, followers and the LIVE Pro badge, to find creators worth recruiting. Below the Agency plan, handles are hidden and the numbers are ranges. sort: score | diamonds30d | coins30d | followers | rank | priority; page with cursor.

excludeLivePro.description: Hide current LIVE Pro badge holders (default true).

maxCoins30d.description: Drop creators whose 30-day estimate is above this (default ceiling 500,000).

worthChecking.description: Only creators with a 30-day estimate >= 50,000 and >= 4 days with a TikTok number.

name: recruit_list
